snippet.title: Leaving home
snippet.description:
Leaving home, a point-and-click adventure filled with quirky puzzles, because some mornings feel heavier than others. Out now!
On mobile the game is free and ad-supported: 
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/leaving-home/id6745894243
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.com.bartbonte.leavinghome
The PC version is a premium experience:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726770/Leaving_Home/
Itchio: https://bartbonte.itch.io/leaving-home
